what: Commit path currently copies the whole staged run tree before any proposed breadcrumb redaction step
scenario_or_breakage: Raw $RUN_DIR/breadcrumbs files can be copied into larch-logs before the redacted copy is produced, leaving secrets in the working tree or staged commit
suggested_fix: Change commit staging to exclude breadcrumbs from the blanket cp, redact into a temporary repo_path, then atomically publish only the sanitized breadcrumbs directory

what: The plan tries to register breadcrumbs/ as a normal larch-log batch even though the registry models single files with extension/mode/sanitizer fields
scenario_or_breakage: A breadcrumbs/ row cannot represent a directory or a sanitizer command with arguments and will conflict with batch path construction and batch-table tests
suggested_fix: Add an explicit directory-batch contract/helper for breadcrumbs or keep breadcrumbs as a commit-only special case; update scripts/test-larch-logs-batches.sh to validate that model

what: ci-wait migration relies on emit_breadcrumb for stderr progress, but emit_breadcrumb writes newline-terminated text to quiet stdout/log when no stream is set
scenario_or_breakage: Dot progress at scripts/ci-wait.sh:268 gains newlines or disappears from stderr, violating the plan's byte-for-byte unset-stream compatibility requirement
suggested_fix: Add a ci-wait progress helper that writes structured breadcrumb records only when LARCH_BREADCRUMB_STREAM is set and otherwise uses larch_errf with the existing no-newline formatting, or extend emit_breadcrumb with an explicit stderr/no-newline mode

what: Category migration omits emit_breadcrumb calls in the sourced Step 5 loop file
scenario_or_breakage: Under run-step5-review's LARCH_BREADCRUMB_STREAM, these breadcrumbs emit WARN unknown-category and are dropped from the stream
suggested_fix: Update review-implement-step5-loop.sh callsites with categories and include them in the review-and-fix breadcrumb regression tests

what: Path-scope plan preserves IMPLEMENT/DESIGN/REVIEW only, but documented callers allocate streams under RESEARCH_TMPDIR
scenario_or_breakage: /research collect-agent-results monitor invocations will fail path validation with exit 2 before streaming or completion coupling
suggested_fix: Add RESEARCH_TMPDIR to larch_bm_under_session_tmp and the path-scope tests, or remove/replace the research breadcrumb-monitor caller fences so docs and enforcement match
